sources.title: Scholer et al. (2020) avian survival meta-analysis dataset, ELEscholer2020_data.csv (Dryad; mirrored on Zenodo, record 3986104)
sources.note: Row X=710: Camaroptera brachyura, Peach et al. (2001), Nchalo, Malawi; survival 0.735 (SE 0.062), mark-recapture, resident, mass 9.3 g, duration 16. Apparent survival: emigration biases it low.

conservation.iucn.note: Infobox status LC citing BirdLife 2016; not checked at the IUCN source.

range.native.note: Country list derived from the Wikipedia subspecies localities (pileata SE Kenya and SE Tanzania; fugglescouchmani NE Zambia, N Malawi, E Tanzania; bororensis S Tanzania, S Malawi, N Mozambique; constans SE Zimbabwe, S Mozambique, NE South Africa; brachyura S and E South Africa). Uganda is not in any listed locality; see the blocker comment.

traits.mass_kg.note: Single study-level mass (9.3 g) from the Scholer dataset row X=710; not a population mean.

traits.length_m.note: 'These 11.5 cm long warblers' (11.5 cm converted to 0.115 m).

traits.lifespan_y.note: Mean adult lifespan from apparent annual survival phi=0.735 (Scholer dataset row X=710, Peach et al. 2001, Nchalo, Malawi): L = -1/ln(phi) = 3.25 years, rounded to 3.2. Assumes constant annual survival of adults, ignores first-year mortality and between-individual heterogeneity, and uses one population. Apparent survival is biased low where emigration occurs, so the true mean may be higher. Not a maximum or captive age.

traits.nest_type.note: 'binds large leaves together low in a bush and builds a grass nest within the leaves': closest enum is Cup; the nest is enclosed by leaves.

traits.diet.note: 'Like most members in the group, green-backed camaroptera is insectivorous.'

traits.locomotion_modes.note: Authored judgement: a skulking passerine that forages low in dense cover, so Hop and Fly; no gait source checked.

traits.social.note: Authored judgement; no social-structure source checked.

traits.activity_pattern.note: Authored judgement for a songbird; the activity curve is the empirical source of seasonality.

traits.defense.note: Authored judgement; a skulking bird that flees into cover.

traits.wariness.note: Authored judgement for behaviour; not sourced.

habitat.note: Stratum shares and resources are authored from 'typically found low in dense cover' and the nest in bound leaves; no quantitative source.

seasonal.strategy.note: 'resident' migration status (Scholer row X=710) and 'a resident breeder' (Wikipedia).

seasonal.phases.note: Authored year-round placeholder. No breeding calendar for Uganda or any other region was sourced.

look.note: Authored judgement. Colours follow the Wikipedia description (green upperparts, olive wings, whitish grey underparts).

behavior.note: Shared bt-perching-songbird-v1 selected for a small perching bird; its nest window is not checked against the species calendar (see blocker).
